editorial.blurb: Adda brings authentic Indian cuisine to Chicago with real spices, consistent quality, and a refined, welcoming atmosphere that keeps locals coming back month after month.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Biryani to experience the real spices—reviewers specifically praise the bay leaves, cinnamon sticks, and pepper pods that give it depth. Go for breakfast if you can catch their Halwa Pori service, which reviewers rave about for its light, fluffy poris.
